## Themes, your own app and tray icons, neon category icons

- **Themes.** View → Themes holds Modern style, NDM Style and themes you install. A theme can change colours, fonts, sizes, corner shapes, backgrounds and the toolbar and category pictures, and only the parts it names; your downloads and settings stay as they are. **Install theme...**, **Create theme...**, **Reload theme** and **Open themes folder** are in the same menu, and the README describes the format.
- **Your own app and tray icons.** View → NDM icon → **Choose icon...** changes NDM's window, taskbar, dialog, About and drop-target icon, and your Windows shortcuts, Linux launcher or macOS Dock icon. View → NDM tray icon offers Default, **Choose icon...** or Don't show. PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, ICO and self-contained SVG pictures work; NDM converts them to the sizes each system needs. **Default** brings NDM's own icon back.
- **NDM Style's category icons are neon**, like its toolbar: each item in the category tree has its own colour (cyan All Downloads, orange Unfinished, green Finished, red Video, pink Music, and so on), brighter with a soft glow when hovered or selected. Themes can set each colour (`categories.video`, `categories.queue-running`...).
- **Drop-down menus** keep their width fitted to their contents at any custom text size.
- **Simpler View menu**: the old Classic style, the Small/Large toolbar button presets and the 3D tray picture are gone; View → Custom scale sizes the toolbar, and settings that chose a removed option now use the default.
- **Spanish, French and Arabic** include all the new messages.
